create_CountableIterator: create a CountableIterator wrapping an iterator with a known total count for progress bar support
use_CountableIterator_len: use len() on a CountableIterator to get the total item count for display purposes
iterate_CountableIterator: iterate over a CountableIterator using next() to yield items from the wrapped iterator
handle_CountableIterator_no_len: handle TypeError when calling len() on a CountableIterator with an unknown total count
wrap_iterator_with_count: wrap any Python iterator with CountableIterator to add length support for progress tracking
